Company Overview
Qibby is the platform that care operations run on.

HQ: New York
Company Size: 200 employees
Years in Business: 4
Qibby Saves LLC
[[zelda:slide 3]]
Problem
Healthcare operations are fragmented, inefficient, and difficult to scale.
Care teams lack unified operational visibility.
Administrative inefficiencies increase costs and reduce patient outcomes.
Qibby Saves LLC
[[zelda:slide 4]]
Solution
Qibby centralizes healthcare operations into one platform.
Improves workforce coordination.
Enhances operational efficiency and scalability.
Supports modern care delivery systems.
Qibby Saves LLC
[[zelda:slide 5]]

Healthcare technology market continues rapid expansion.
Growing demand for operational healthcare platforms.
Large addressable market among hospitals, clinics, and care providers.
Qibby Saves LLC

Enterprise SaaS platform.
Recurring subscription revenue.
Implementation and onboarding services.
Long-term healthcare partnerships.
